messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a staged enable for pegasus-13b (catalog: pegasus, variant: quant-v0). Change window 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling canary -> regional ramp -> global. Expect ~15% cost delta on token unit for quant path.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by sam. Canary env = eu-west1, us-central1. Canary target: 5% traffic for 30m, health checks every 30s.

canary-bot: canary-run initiated: pegasus-13b-quant-v0 (3 replicas) — health=starting.

claire: quick q — what's the explicit fallback ordering if quant fails mid-cutover? need to document for on-call.

mike: fallback ladder will be: pegasus-13b-quant -> pegasus-13b-fp16 -> pegasus-7b-cpu. We prefer same-arch first (fp16) then smaller model.

henri: EU infra ok for the change window but note dedicated eu-1 customers may have pinned catalog_versions. We should surface a pin-check step in runbook.

anita: adding pin checklist: verify `redwoodctl catalog list-pins --region eu-1` before ramp, send customer-notify if any pins conflict. Also confirm KMS access for private deploys.

sam: good call. We'll add a preflight gating step: 1) pin-check, 2) safety-eval (sample prompts), 3) perf smoke (50r/s), 4) canary health stable 30m.

lex: rollback plan (documented):
```
# fast rollback to previous catalog revision
redwoodctl catalog set-default --catalog pegasus --revision 20260310
# emergency route override to smallest stable model
redwoodctl routing override --catalog pegasus --fallback-order "pegasus-7b-cpu" --ttl 300
```
If we see error rate spike >1.5% or p95 latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2367890200. Initial metrics: qps=2.3, p50=120ms, p95=210ms, error_rate=0.0%.

mike: note: quant-v0 has known edgecase with long-context prompt truncation — safety-eval should include our longest 4 evals.

claire: i'll own the safety-eval and attach the prompt set. Also will run a staging load test at 200r/s to validate batching behavior.

anita: customer pin list added to the runbook; flagged two customers in eu-1 with pinned revisions — ops to reach out if we need consent.

henri: infra will enable extra headroom in eu-west1 during the window (+20% capacity). Alerting: p95 > 400ms -> page eng-oncall.

canary-bot: canary healthy at 2367890350. p95=220ms, cost delta tracked +13%. No errors.

sam: if canary stays green for 30m we ramp to 30% and runfull smoke. If any of the checks fail we execute lex's rollback cmds. Document updated with timings. :thumbsup:

mike: leaving notes in the release PR about quant->fp16 fallbacks and perf expectations.

claire: will post final signoff in this thread once staging load is green.

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window set and release-notes draft attached to PR #4521 (link: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/4521).
